description:
Due to the Burlington Streetscape project, MLK Jr. Avenue at the Kirkwood Supestop is closed. Route 31 Magnolia is on a long-term detour until further notice. 

Outbound from Magnolia Avenue, right on Kirkwood Street, left on Holston Drive, right on Prosser Road, left on MLK Jr., to the regular route.

Inbound from MLK Jr., right on Prosser Road, left on Holston Drive, right on Kirkwood Street, left on Magnolia Avenue to the regular route.

While Knox County schools are in session, Route 40, South Knoxville, will be on a long-term detour, for the 2:15 trip, INBOUND ONLY, Monday through Friday.

Inbound from Moody Avenue, continue straight into Sevierville Pike, left on Compton Street, left on Haywood Avenue, left on Cottrell Street, left on Wynn, right on Moody Avenue to the regular route.
header: Long -Term Detour for Route 40: South Knoxville

description:
Due to construction, Route 32 will be on a long-term detour. 

The outbound routing will be as follows:
From Oakland, left onto Ashland, right onto Andes, right onto MLK, left onto Lakeside, right onto Magnolia, right onto Prosser, right onto Holston/Kirkwood. 

The inbound trip will be as follows: From Kirkwood, left on Magnolia, left on Lakeside, left on Andes, left on Ashland, right on Oakland, to the regular route.

Due to construction on Sevier at McClung, Route 40 will be on a long-term detour until September 25.

Outbound from Sevier, left on Wynn, left on Moody to the regular route.

Inbound from Moody, right on Wynn, right on Sevier, to the regular route.

Passengers, please wait for the bus at the corner of Sevier and Wynn or Moody and Davenport.

Due to closure of Clinch Ave at World's Fair Park Drive, Route 42 will be detoured on 9/6.

Outbound from Church Ave, left on Locust, right on Cumberland, right on 16th, left on Clinch, to the regular route.

Inbound from Cumberland into Main, left on State, right on Church to Knoxville Station.
